cards.example_en: Some animals may die out if we do nothing.
cards.example_zh: 如果我们什么都不做，有些动物可能会灭绝。

cards.example_en: Your result may differ from the key.
cards.example_zh: 你的结果可能不同于答案。

cards.example_en: The twins differ in height.
cards.example_zh: 这对双胞胎在身高上有差别。

cards.example_en: Can you distinguish fact from opinion?
cards.example_zh: 你能把事实和观点区分开吗？

cards.example_en: Let us dive into chapter three.
cards.example_zh: 我们投入去做第三章吧。

cards.example_en: They do a good job on the group project.
cards.example_zh: 他们的小组作业干得不错。

cards.example_en: The school will do away with paper tickets.
cards.example_zh: 学校将废除纸质票据。

cards.example_en: They do their best on the oral test.
cards.example_zh: 他们在口试上尽自己最大努力。

cards.example_en: They do homework in the study room.
cards.example_zh: 他们在自习室做作业。

cards.example_en: We do sports on the school field.
cards.example_zh: 我们在学校操场进行体育活动。

cards.example_en: She can do well in history.
cards.example_zh: 她能把历史学好。

cards.example_en: Good writers draw on daily life.
cards.example_zh: 好的作者借鉴日常生活。

cards.example_en: The class will draw up a small budget.
cards.example_zh: 班级将起草一份小预算。

cards.example_en: I sometimes dream about the old campus.
cards.example_zh: 我有时梦见老校园。

cards.example_en: Many children dream of becoming a pilot.
cards.example_zh: 许多孩子梦想成为飞行员。

cards.example_en: If you rush, you may end up with errors.
cards.example_zh: 如果赶工，你到头来可能会出错。

cards.example_en: We must face up to the calculation error.
cards.example_zh: 我们必须正视这个计算错误。

cards.example_en: The village is far from the city.
cards.example_zh: 村子离城市很远。

cards.example_en: Can you figure out the last step?
cards.example_zh: 你能想明白最后一步吗？

cards.example_en: Try to get your main idea across.
cards.example_zh: 尽量把你的主要意思讲清楚。

cards.example_en: I get along with my deskmate.
cards.example_zh: 我和同桌相处得好。

cards.example_en: After lunch we get down to revision.
cards.example_zh: 午饭后我们开始认真复习。

cards.example_en: I get dressed before breakfast.
cards.example_zh: 我早饭前穿好衣服。

cards.example_en: Please get in touch before Monday.
cards.example_zh: 请在星期一之前取得联系。

cards.example_en: Take a map so you do not get lost.
cards.example_zh: 带上地图，免得迷路。

cards.example_en: They want to get married in a small garden.
cards.example_zh: 他们想在一个小花园里结婚。

cards.example_en: We get off at the next stop.
cards.example_zh: 我们下一站下车。

cards.example_en: Get on the bus at the school gate.
cards.example_zh: 在校门口上车。

cards.example_en: It is hard to get out of a bad habit.
cards.example_zh: 坏习惯很难摆脱。

cards.example_en: It takes time to get over a cold.
cards.example_zh: 感冒好起来需要时间。

cards.example_en: Please get rid of these old boxes.
cards.example_zh: 请把这些旧箱子除掉。

cards.example_en: I cannot get through to the office.
cards.example_zh: 我打不通办公室的电话。

cards.example_en: What time do we get to the museum?
cards.example_zh: 我们几点到达博物馆？

cards.example_en: The family will get together on New Year's Day.
cards.example_zh: 这家人将在元旦聚会。

cards.example_en: I get up at six on weekdays.
cards.example_zh: 工作日我六点起床。

cards.example_en: The head teacher will give a speech.
cards.example_zh: 班主任将发表演讲。

cards.example_en: The sign can give a warning.
cards.example_zh: 这块牌子可以发出警告。

cards.example_en: We give away old clothes every spring.
cards.example_zh: 每年春天我们捐赠旧衣服。

cards.example_en: Do not give in when the work is hard.
cards.example_zh: 作业难的时候也别屈服。

cards.example_en: The flowers give off a sweet smell.
cards.example_zh: 这些花发出甜甜的气味。

cards.example_en: Please give out the worksheets.
cards.example_zh: 请把练习纸分发下去。

cards.example_en: A rumour can give rise to panic.
cards.example_zh: 谣言可能引发恐慌。

cards.example_en: Do not give up. Try one more time.
cards.example_zh: 别放弃，再试一次。

cards.example_en: She does not go in for loud games.
cards.example_zh: 她不爱好参加喧闹的游戏。

cards.example_en: She has to go through the form again.
cards.example_zh: 她得再仔细看一遍表格。

cards.example_en: Please hand in the essay by Friday.
cards.example_zh: 请在星期五前上交文章。

cards.example_en: I will hand out the worksheets.
cards.example_zh: 我会把练习纸分发给大家。
